title: Participating in Meetings

questions.prompt: I'd like to suggest ___ the schedule.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is "changing". Read the full sentence aloud and notice how the words fit together.
questions.hint: Read each option as a complete sentence before choosing.

application.prompt: Your team has a difficult deadline. Suggest a solution, acknowledge a colleague, and confirm the next step.
checklist: I used at least two phrases from this week.
I included a clear main idea.
I added a reason or example.

completionRule: Attempt all five questions and review explanations
